question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Fear of water
solution:
The correct answer is '**Hydrophobia**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Hydrophobia** (जल का भय) - Fear of water.
 
• **Bibliophobia** (पुस्तकों का भय) - Fear of books.
 
• **Microphobia** (छोटी चीजों का भय) - Fear of small things.
 
• **Botanophobia** (पौधों का भय) - Fear of plants.
